sources.title: Cupid Limited shareholder notices including Q2 FY27 business update
Cupid share price, Q2 guidance and current company news
Cupid valuation, profitability and sector metrics

claims.statement: Cupid's latest business update and recent financial record show strong growth momentum; FY27 revenue guidance was raised to about Rs 800 crore and FY26 revenue growth was very strong, supporting a positive fundamentals conclusion.

June 2026 shareholding data show FII/FPI ownership rising from about 1.01% to 4.17%, mutual funds from 0.15% to 0.33%, total institutional ownership from 1.18% to 4.51%, and promoter pledge reducing sharply; this is a positive institutional-behaviour signal.
The company raised FY27 guidance and entered the Nifty Smallcap 250, both of which are positive near-term catalysts alongside continuing expansion disclosures.

At roughly Rs 312.50, public market data place Cupid above 300x trailing earnings and around 93x book versus a sector P/E near 37x; despite strong growth, this is an extremely rich valuation and is independently classified negative.
Current company and market disclosures reviewed through 4 October show no verified adverse binary or severe event shock; the current event-shock conclusion is neutral/no material adverse shock.

limitations: Research was freshly executed for this distinct G5.1 acceptance run; no prior bundle was merely retimestamped or reused.
VERIFIED_NEUTRAL is used only where current evidence was actively checked and no material directional signal was established.
Valuation conclusions are contextual and do not replace the frozen provider score; independent research validates, conflicts with or excludes provider interpretation under governed reconciliation.
